text:
Glad that all clicked into place! When you're ready to keep going, some natural next steps from here could be

- **building chord progressions** in minor keys (i – iv – V – i, etc.)
- **writing a B section** to contrast with your motif
- **exploring modes** like Dorian or Phrygian, which sit between major and minor

Whatever direction your piece takes you, feel free to bring it back and we can work through it.
